summary: Rebuild has 420 five-star reviews and patients who say every session counts. But downtown Toronto works long hours: nearby clinics open at 7am, stay open until 8pm and see patients on Saturdays, while you close at 5pm on weekdays.
visibility: In our search for physiotherapy in downtown Toronto, several clinics with similar ratings appeared together, most with longer hours than yours.
lead: Patients praise root-cause assessment and 'never an unnecessary session'.
lose: Office workers who can only come before 8:30am, after 5pm or on Saturday book elsewhere.
Clinics with similar ratings appear next to you in every search.
Your speciality in post-surgery rehab isn't visible to new patients.

gaps.title: Your hours don't match downtown life
gaps.detail: Most office workers can only come early, late or at weekends. Online booking and clear availability help you keep the ones you can fit in.

gaps.title: Every patient looks the same in a search
gaps.detail: With similar ratings everywhere, your 'no unnecessary sessions' promise is what makes you different, but nobody sees it before booking.

gaps.title: Insurance-covered patients don't come back
gaps.detail: Many patients have yearly coverage they forget to use. A reminder before it resets brings them back.

actions.title: Show your promise: no unnecessary sessions
actions.why: It's the message that makes patients choose you over similar clinics.

actions.title: Remind patients about unused insurance coverage
actions.why: Doable today: a short email to past patients before year-end.

actions.title: Let patients book online
actions.why: Patients see your next free slot instantly instead of calling around.
